evidence.observation: Type-Fest is an owned, actively community-maintained TypeScript utility-type library with strict environment requirements, a large type-level API and explicit contribution/review processes.
does_not_support: sole authorship of every type utility

evidence.observation: Ky is an owned HTTP-client library with an intentionally small Fetch-based API and detailed cross-runtime retry, timeout, hook and schema-validation semantics.
A recent sindresorhus-authored Ky commit fixes a flaky timing test by changing assertions from narrow timing-dependent counts to behavior-preserving invariants.
Awesome is an owned, long-running curated ecosystem with explicit contribution/list-creation rules and many externally maintained topic lists.
